blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Northern Mindanao police seized nearly half a million pesos’ worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes during operations in Iligan City and Misamis Occidental on Sunday night, Oct. 18. The Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) reported confiscating a total of 597 reams of illicit cigarettes valued at P477,600. In Iligan City, authorities flagged down an orange Toyota Hilux at a checkpoint in Barangay Dalipuga. Police seized 250 reams of “Modern” brand cigarettes worth P200,000 after the driver failed to present the required importation and tax documents.
